title: Add request-logging and CORS middleware to Go todo server
description: A Go HTTP todo server handles GET and POST /todos with no middleware. Add a logging middleware (logs method + path + status + duration) and a CORS middleware (adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for all responses). Wire both into main.go.

task_spec.prompt:
Add middleware to the Go HTTP server:

1. Create internal/middleware/logger.go with func Logger(next http.Handler) http.Handler that wraps next, records start time, calls next via a response-capturing writer, and logs: METHOD PATH STATUS DURATIONms to stdout.

2. Create internal/middleware/cors.go with func CORS(next http.Handler) http.Handler that adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * to every response. Handle OPTIONS preflight with 204.

3. Wire both in cmd/server/main.go: chain as CORS(Logger(mux)).

4. Add tests in internal/middleware/logger_test.go and cors_test.go using httptest. At least 2 tests each.

All existing tests must still pass: go test ./...
success_criteria: Logger middleware records method, path, status, duration
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
